name: Fairmont Hamilton Princess & Beach Club
positioning: Pink-painted harborfront hotel in Hamilton, Bermuda, with a marina and a private beach club (the official name is Hamilton Princess & Beach Club, A Fairmont Hotel)
best_for: Travelers who want a central Hamilton base with a private beach club
Art lovers drawn to a pop art collection on display in the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is known as the "Pink Palace".
The hotel has stood in the City of Hamilton since 1885.
The hotel is in the heart of Hamilton, a five-minute walk to shops, restaurants and attractions.
The hotel has a full-service marina and a private beach club.
16o9 is an open-air cantina at the hotel serving Mexican food.
Crown & Anchor is the hotel's casual bar and restaurant serving all-day casual dishes.
Fairmont Gold rooms include access to the Gold Lounge, with breakfast, afternoon tea and evening canapés.
Signature Harborview rooms in the main building have expansive balconies and views of Hamilton Harbor.
In 2025 the Bermudiana wing was renovated into all-suite, waterway-facing rooms.

highlights.text: The hotel's pop art collection includes works by Andy Warhol, Banksy and Damien Hirst.
The hotel's private beach club is in Southampton and is for exclusive use.
Intrepid Bermuda is a steakhouse at the hotel inspired by a James Bond hideaway.
The hotel has a harborfront infinity pool with private cabanas.

considerations.text: The private beach club is in Southampton, not at the hotel; guests take the hotel's free jitney there, which makes several runs a day.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury Bermuda properties.
